verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents per-agent scoped delegation on agent wallets. Each agent gets its own signer bound to a user-approved permission set: a spend cap, allowed counterparties, and a time window, enforced onchain, and "the user can revoke at any time." Agent cards are order intents with a fixed allowance, merchant lock, and expiration that stop working when cancelled, and agent checkouts take a spending cap. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit documentation that revocation takes effect instantly (latency of onchain or card-intent cancellation is unspecified).
